topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design significantly impacts signal quality, influencing encrypted traffic classification accuracy. Factors like polarization correlation coefficient, operating frequency, and antenna array complexity affect signal integrity. Adaptive modulation, channel coding, and MIMO techniques optimize signal reliability, enhancing classification accuracy.
reference_context: Structured data highlights antenna complexity, polarization correlation coefficients, and operating frequencies as key factors in SatCom systems.
